definitions.explanation: The application of scientific principles to design and build machines, structures, and systems.

notes:
{工学|こうがく} refers to engineering, the application of science and math to design practical solutions.

ETYMOLOGY:
{工|こう} (craft, industry) + ⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧ (study) = engineering studies

COMMON BRANCHES:
- ⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧{工学|こうがく}: mechanical engineering
- ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧{工学|こうがく}: electrical engineering
- ⟦{土木|どぼく}→土木：20599_doboku⟧{工学|こうがく}: civil engineering
- ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧{工学|こうがく}: information/computer engineering
- ⟦{化学|かがく}→化学：05336_kagaku_chem⟧{工学|こうがく}: chemical engineering
- ⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧{工学|こうがく}: architectural engineering

ACADEMIC TERMS:
- ⟦{工学部|こうがくぶ}→工学部：24493_kougakubu⟧: engineering department/faculty
- {工学|こうがく}⟦{博士|はかせ}→博士：03551_hakase⟧: PhD in engineering
- {工学|こうがく}⟦{修士|しゅうし}→修士：11098_shuushi⟧: Master's in engineering

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{理学|りがく}→理学：28867_rigaku⟧ (science) focuses on theoretical understanding, while {工学|こうがく} (engineering) focuses on practical applications.
